A rule folds a component the reading does not say into the suffix after it: the letter stays written (the Hebrew is never changed), it is not pronounced and carries no label of its own. root = the root component's letters; sn = its Strong's; fold = the css of the component folded away; into = the css of the suffix that takes it; retired / form = the spelling no reading text may carry any more and the one it becomes (prefixes Wa/Ha/Ba/La/Ma/Ka/Sha stay in front). Read by modform-lib.mjs (reading text + parallel gate), build-surface-index.js and server.js (the Parallel chips).
